exposure: gestational exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5)
cohort: The study included 72 pregnant participants from the CellulaR Injury and Preterm Birth Study.
finding: Gestational exposure to black carbon, particularly during gestational months 3-5, was associated with increased odds of spontaneous preterm birth, an association mediated by altered placental gene expression (MPO, ELANE, and GNRH2).
gest_age: Outcome was defined as early spontaneous preterm birth (<32 weeks); exposures were measured during the first 20 weeks of pregnancy.
